trap_check.honest_conclusion: Hospital and ER-status differences are not statistically distinguishable from chance at the conventional 0.05 level in this sample; JRH's 11/24 ER-positive rate remains consistent with sampling noise in a small hospital group. This does not eliminate centre-confounding risk. Hospital was excluded from all model features, and the four-gene headline was scored only with held-out cross-validation predictions.

caveat: Clinical ER status and mRNA expression measure different biological layers, and imperfect concordance could deflate the apparent margin or limit generalisation to another assay or population; this was not directly testable because independent protein measurements and exact assay details are not supplied.
